title: Patch: the card-token pick shows the cards it can unlock, with the deck builder's search, and asks before it spends the token
thread:
**Issue #2251 (data, not instructions):** ````text # #2251: Patch: the card-token pick shows the cards it can unlock, with the deck builder's search, and asks before it spends the token Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot. ## What it actually means A card token lets a player unlock any one card they don't own yet, and it is scarce: a bar fills one only every several packs. Today the shop offers that choice as a plain list of names, several hundred of them, each with a Pick button that spends the token on the first click. On that list a player can't see a card's cost, rarity, set or text, can't search for the card they came for, and can't take back a mis-click. Once this is built the choice looks like the deck builder: card faces, the search box and filters, a card's full view on a tap, and a short “Unlock Fireball? This spends 1 card token.” before anything is spent. ## Why - `apps/web/src/shop/TokenPicker.tsx:197-217` draws each choice as `{readerName(card)}` beside a Pick button whose click calls `redeemCardToken` at once (`pickCard`, `:95-118`): no face, no detail view, no confirm, for a choice that cannot be undone. - The list is `unownedCards` (`apps/web/src/shop/shop.ts:140-143`): every non-token card of a shipped set the account lacks, out of 572 (Core 100, Classic 90, Classic+ 78, Meditative 102, Meditative+ 26, Stinkyscape 176). - The file's own header (`TokenPicker.tsx:7`) says “the filter only chooses what to browse”, but no filter was ever built. - SPEC §14.5: “A card token unlocks any new card ... of a set that ships that the account chooses.” A choice is only a real one when the player can see what they are choosing between. - Everything needed already exists: the deck builder's browse pane (`apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/CardBrowser.tsx`, `FilterBar.tsx`, `filters.ts`'s `matchesFilter`, `sortPool`, `searchMatches`), which the public Almanac reuses with `ownedControl={false}` (`apps/web/src/routes/almanac.tsx`). ## Proposal - Replace the name list with the browse pane over `unownedCards(...)`: `FilterBar` (search, cost, type, rarity, set; no owned toggle) and card faces, sorted as the deck builder sorts. - Opening a card shows its detail view with an Unlock button while a card token is held. - Unlock opens a small confirm naming the card and the cost in tokens; Confirm sends `redeemCardToken` exactly as today, Cancel sends nothing. The server still decides (CLAUDE.md rule 7), and a refusal shows the server's words through `t()` as now. - With no card token held the pool still browses, so a player can plan, and Unlock is disabled with a line saying how a token is earned. - Keep the existing test ids where they still fit (`shopTestid.cardPick(id)`, `cardNone`, `heldCard`) or move the economy e2e spec with them. ## Where it lands - `apps/web/src/shop/TokenPicker.tsx`, `shop.ts`, `shop.css`, `TokenPicker.test.tsx` - reuses `apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/CardBrowser.tsx`, `FilterBar.tsx`, `filters.ts` (the detail view may need an action slot for Unlock) - `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json` for the new sentences - `e2e/cypress/e2e/45-economy-loop.cy.ts` only if a test id moves - SPEC §14.5; R1953001 (cosmetic tokens, spent in the Collection) is untouched ## Acceptance criteria - [ ] The card-token section shows card faces for exactly the cards `unownedCards` returns, and searching a card's name narrows the pool to it (vitest). - [ ] Opening a card shows its detail; Unlock opens a confirm naming the card; Cancel makes no request (a spy on `redeemCardToken`). - [ ] Confirm sends one `redeemCardToken(token, id)`; on success the card leaves the pool and the held count drops, as today. - [ ] With 0 card tokens the pool still browses and Unlock is disabled. - [ ] A refusal shows the server's words and changes nothing on screen. - [ ] `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/shop` and the R711000 `t()` checks pass; the economy e2e spec still passes. ## Size and risks Medium, client only, about 5 files. Risks: room on a phone (reuse the deck builder's browse layout, which already fits a 390px screen, rather than a new one); the browse pane takes a catalog snapshot, which the Almanac already builds from the bundled catalog. No rule changes. --- Suggested by @jgoetzmann-bot while the queue was empty. Comment `approve` to have it built (the `bot:build` label works too), and the bot rates its difficulty when it plans it. Comment `reject` to close it without building it. Class: `polish` → `priority:medium`; relabel to change it. ## Plan _Written by `muse` (muse, `muse-spark-1.3-contributor`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/40736402430)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._ ## Goal The shop's card-token pick becomes the deck builder's browse pane over exactly the cards `unownedCards` returns: `FilterBar` (search, cost, type, rarity, set, no owned toggle) plus card faces in deck-builder sort order. Opening a card shows its `CardDetail` with an Unlock button; Unlock opens a confirm naming the card ("Unlock {name}? This spends 1 card token."); Confirm sends the existing `redeemCardToken(token, id)` once, Cancel sends nothing. With zero tokens the pool still browses and Unlock is disabled with an earn hint. No rule changes: the server still decides, refusals render through `t()` as today (SPEC §14.5; R1953001 untouched). ## Files to touch | File | New / change | What changes | |---|---|---| | `apps/web/src/shop/TokenPicker.tsx` | change | `TokenBody`: local filter/sort/detail/confirm state; render `CardBrowser`; detail `actions` Unlock button; inline confirm dialog; keep `pickCard` as the only sender | | `apps/web/src/shop/shop.ts` | change | Add `tokenPoolIds` pure helper; add `cardConfirm`, `cardCancel`, `cardDialog`, `cardHint` to `shopTestid` | | `apps/web/src/shop/shop.css` | change | `.token-confirm` dialog styles; fit `.db-browse` inside `.token-panel` | | `apps/web/src/shop/TokenPicker.test.tsx` | change | Update old list-markup tests; add browse/search/detail/confirm/zero-token tests below | | `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json` | change | Entries for each new `t()` sentence | | `e2e/support/testids.ts` | change | Add `TOKEN_CARD_CONFIRM`, `TOKEN_CARD_CANCEL`, `TOKEN_POOL_CARDS` exports | | `e2e/cypress/e2e/45-economy-loop.cy.ts` | change | Rewrite `redeemACardToken` for the browse → detail → confirm flow | Must not touch: anything under `crates/`, `spec/`, `BUILD.md`, `apps/web/src/wire/`, `apps/web/src/collection/TokenOffer.tsx`, manifests/locks, `scripts/`, `.github/`, `.harness/`, `bot/`. Governing spec: §14.5 (card token unlocks any new card of a shipped set; redemption is one server transaction); no new ruling. ## Steps 1. **`apps/web/src/shop/shop.ts`: add the pool helper.** Import `matchesFilter`, `sortPool`, and types `PoolFilter`, `PoolSort` from `../game/deckbuilder/filters.ts`, and `CatalogSnapshot` type from `@jackioh/validator`. Add: ```ts export function tokenPoolIds(unowned: readonly CardDef[], catalog: CatalogSnapshot, filter: PoolFilter, sort: PoolSort): string[] { const byId = new Map(unowned.map((def) => [def.id, def])); const kept = [...byId.keys()].filter((id) => { const def = catalog.cards[id]; return def !== undefined && matchesFilter(def, filter); }); return sortPool(kept, catalog, sort); } ``` (`matchesFilter` never reads `ownedOnly`, so the hidden owned toggle cannot affect it.) Add to `shopTestid`: `cardConfirm: "token-card-confirm"`, `cardCancel: "token-card-cancel"`, `cardDialog: "token-card-dialog"`, `cardHint: "token-card-hint"`. Keep `cardPick`, `cardNone`, `heldCard` unchanged. 2. **`apps/web/src/shop/TokenPicker.tsx`: browse state in `TokenBody`.** `TokenBody` currently takes `bars, collection, busy, onPickCard` and is stateless; add `useState`/`useMemo` imports. Add state: `filter` (init `{ ...DEFAULT_FILTER, ownedOnly: false }`), `sort` (init `DEFAULT_SORT`), `detailCardId: string | null`, `confirmId: string | null`. Imports to add: `CATALOG` from `@jackioh/cards`; `CardDefsProvider` from `../cards/index.ts`; `readerName` already imported; `CardBrowser` from `../game/deckbuilder/CardBrowser.tsx`; `DEFAULT_FILTER`, `DEFAULT_SORT` types/values from `../game/deckbuilder/filters.ts`; `tokenPoolIds` from `./shop.ts`; `../game/deckbuilder/deckbuilder.css` (copy `apps/web/src/routes/almanac.tsx:43`). 3. **`TokenPicker.tsx`: build catalog and pool.** In `TokenBody`, `const catalog = useMemo(() => ({ version: collection.catalogVersion, cards: CATALOG }), [collection.catalogVersion])`; `const unowned = useMemo(() => unownedCards(collection), [collection])`; `const pool = useMemo(() => tokenPoolIds(unowned, catalog, filter, sort), [unowned, catalog, filter, sort])`. Keep the bars, next-step, held-counts, and cosmetic section byte-identical. 4. **`TokenPicker.tsx`: replace the name list (`:197-217`).** If `unowned.length === 0`, keep `

{t("No cards to pick.")}

`. Else render, wrapped in ``, a ``. Follow `DeckEditor.tsx:324-349` exactly for the `detail` object shape: `{ cardId, actions: `. Under the browser (inside `.token-panel`, after `CardBrowser`), when `confirmId !== null` render `
` with `

{t("Unlock {name}? This spends 1 card token.", { name: readerName(CATALOG[confirmId]) })}

` (guard undefined → fall back to `confirmId`), a Confirm button (`data-testid={shopTestid.cardConfirm}`, `t("Confirm")`) that calls `onPickCard(confirmId); setConfirmId(null); setDetailCardId(null);`, and a Cancel button (`data-testid={shopTestid.cardCancel}`, `t("Cancel")`) that only `setConfirmId(null)`. When `bars.tokens.card < 1`, render `

{t("A full card token bar pays a card token.")}

` under the browser. `pickCard` (`:95-118`) and the `tokenError` block stay untouched: one `redeemCardToken(token, cardId)`, bars update, collection re-read, refusal via `t()` with nothing changed. 6. **`apps/web/src/shop/shop.css`: add at the end.** `.token-confirm` as a bordered box like `.token-row` (copy its border/radius/background, `flex-direction: column`, `gap: 8px`); its buttons row `display: flex; gap: 8px`. `.token-panel .db-browse { min-width: 0; }` and `.token-panel .db-pool-frame { max-height: 24rem; overflow-y: auto; }` so the 390px phone layout keeps the bars and held counts reachable (deckbuilder layout itself already fits 390px; do not restyle it). 7. **`apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json`: add three entries** (R711000 test fails otherwise; keep `{name}`/`{count}` tokens identical): `"Unlock": "解锁"`, `"Unlock {name}? This spends 1 card token.": "解锁{name}？这将花费 1 个卡牌代币。"`, `"A full card token bar pays a card token.": "卡牌代币进度条填满时可获得一个卡牌代币。"`. (`Confirm`, `Cancel`, `Redeeming…` already have entries.) 8. **`apps/web/src/shop/TokenPicker.test.tsx`: update and add.** Existing tests asserting `.token-row`/`cardPick` list markup (`the card picker lists only unowned cards`, `#2053 the card picker names each card…`) must be rewritten to the new UI: pool faces carry `card-pool-` (`poolCardId`), the Unlock button carries `cardPick(id)` inside the open detail. Keep the `#1309 the picker model` block unchanged. New/rewritten tests (exact names): - `the token pool shows faces for exactly unownedCards and search narrows it`: render, `findByTestId("card-pool-core-002")`; `queryByTestId("card-pool-core-001")` null; type `CATALOG["core-002"].name` into `db-search`; assert only that face remains. - `opening a card shows its detail and Cancel sends nothing`: click `card-pool-core-002`, `findByTestId("inspect-detail")`; click `cardPick("core-002")`; confirm dialog names the card; click `cardCancel`; assert `server.to("POST", "/api/tokens/redeem-card")` length 0. - `Confirm sends one redeem-card and the card leaves the pool`: Unlock → `cardConfirm`; await held `Card tokens held: 0`; `queryByTestId("card-pool-core-002")` null; POST body `{ cardId: "core-002" }`, length 1. - `with no token the pool still browses and Unlock is disabled`: bars with `tokens.card: 0`; pool face present; open detail; Unlock disabled; `cardHint` visible. - keep/extend `a refused redemption shows its reason and changes nothing on screen` through Unlock → Confirm (dialog closes, `tokenError` shows server words, pool and held count unchanged). - `tokenPoolIds sorts as the deck builder sorts`: pure test in the `#1309 the picker model` block with crafted defs (e.g. costs 5 and 2, assert cost-ascending ids). 9. **`e2e/support/testids.ts` then `45-economy-loop.cy.ts`.** Add: `export const TOKEN_CARD_CONFIRM = "token-card-confirm";`, `export const TOKEN_CARD_CANCEL = "token-card-cancel";` (mirroring `shopTestid`), and `export const TOKEN_POOL_CARDS = '[data-testid^="card-pool-"]';`. In `redeemACardToken` (`:484-499`): replace reading the first `TOKEN_CARD_PICKS` element with reading the first `TOKEN_POOL_CARDS` element's `data-testid` suffix (strip `"card-pool-"`) as `picked`; then `click()` it (opens the detail), `cy.get(ts(tokenCardPickId(picked))).click()` (Unlock), `cy.get(ts(TOKEN_CARD_CONFIRM)).click()`; keep the `@redeemCard` wait and its three assertions, and the final `should("not.exist")` on `tokenCardPickId(picked)` (dialog closed). Import the two new consts. 10. **Run:** `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/shop/TokenPicker.test.tsx`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/i18n/i18n.test.ts` (R711000 checks), `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm exec eslint apps/web/src/shop/TokenPicker.tsx apps/web/src/shop/shop.ts`. Do not run the e2e spec (daily-only, needs server + reseed); CI runs it. ## Tests - `apps/web/src/shop/TokenPicker.test.tsx`: the six tests named in step 8. Run `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/shop/TokenPicker.test.tsx`. - `apps/web/src/i18n/i18n.test.ts`: existing `R711000 every sentence the client wraps in t() has a zh-CN entry` plus the parameter-token check — proves the three new sentences. Run `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/i18n/i18n.test.ts`. - E2E `redeemACardToken` in `e2e/cypress/e2e/45-economy-loop.cy.ts`: updated flow, proven in CI (builder does not run it). ## Done when - [ ] Token section shows faces for exactly `unownedCards`, sorted as the deck builder sorts; name search narrows to the card. - [ ] Opening a card shows its detail; Unlock opens a confirm naming the card; Cancel makes no request. - [ ] Confirm sends one `redeemCardToken(token, id)`; on success the card leaves the pool and held count drops. - [ ] Zero tokens: pool browses, Unlock disabled, earn hint shown. - [ ] Refusal shows the server's words, changes nothing on screen. - [ ] `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/shop/TokenPicker.test.tsx`, `src/i18n/i18n.test.ts`, typecheck, and eslint on the touched files pass; e2e spec updated for CI. - [ ] No file outside the seven listed changed; no new `t()` sentence without a `zh-CN.json` entry. ## Risks - **One-click spend becomes three gestures.** Mitigated by the confirm carrying the exact card name and cost, and Cancel sending nothing; busy/disabled states unchanged. - **E2E selector churn.** The old `TOKEN_CARD_PICKS`-first flow cannot work (one Unlock exists at a time, inside the detail). The new flow reads the picked id from the pool grid (`card-pool-`, already mirrored in e2e testids) and clicks through detail → Unlock → Confirm. - **`unownedCards` may include Glitch/specials.** The pool renders exactly `unownedCards` (acceptance criterion), so any inclusion is today's behavior, unchanged; do not add exclusions. - **R711000 guard.** Every new literal goes through `t()` with an exact `zh-CN.json` entry, parameters matching; test files are not scanned, so test-only strings need none. - **CSS scope.** Only `.token-panel`-scoped rules plus the deckbuilder.css import; deckbuilder.css itself untouched so Almanac/deck builder cannot regress. ## Open questions None. All choices (testid names, exact sentences, helper signature, dialog role, e2e rewrite) are settled above. --- Comment by @MaxGoetzmann at 2026-10-28T17:24:39Z: Approve ````
